adversarial-review: Challenge material claims with bounded counterexamples, including exact authority, effect recovery, and evidence integrity.
architecture-candidate-finder: Find and explain evidence-backed candidates for improving design patterns, module boundaries, and architecture decisions.
build-html-prototype: Build document, interface, or visual HTML prototypes inside one disposable folder.
clean-copy: Remove interface text users do not need while keeping facts they need to act, decide, and recover.
cqt-review: Review code and migrations for ownership, dependencies, durable effects, state recovery, and evidence-backed correctness.
dev-process-bot-playtesting-and-tuning: Tune difficulty, thresholds, or other settings with automated bots or replays aimed at a target outcome.
dev-process-deterministic-core-and-repla: Implement recorded-input replay with explicit compatibility, isolated effects, and divergence checks.
dev-process-state-machine-verification: Check stateful event flows for counterexamples with explicit model bounds and implementation regressions.
frontend-system-principles: Build frontend journeys with scoped state, draft and replay recovery, consistent caching, and measured performance.
handoff-to-opencode: Route limited, non-sensitive implementation work to a current free OpenCode model based on task needs within explicit paths.
implementation-quality: Start runnable projects and implement clear owners, complete journeys, generated assets, durable commands, and explicit failure recovery.
local-git-gates: Design or verify thin Git hooks and one canonical gate with dependency-aware routing, exact-commit qualification, CI/self-hosted agreement, regression rules, and performance budgets.
nyan-editorial: Develop ideas and draft or review source-grounded campaign, social, article, and learning content while preserving author judgment and project voice.
nyan-ui-visual-review: Distill or scaffold visual foundations and critique compositions across media, including agent interfaces, using binding grid contracts, measured audits, rendered evidence, and verified optical exceptions.
omelet-orchestrator: Orchestrate grounded work through a thin skill router, with required Stageshow and Nyan visual guidance for all UI and visual work.
saas-perf-hillclimb: Improve SaaS performance one layer at a time with a measured, statistically gated hill-climb loop and a holdout check.
simplified-technical-writing: Rewrite technical prose in strict or STE-flavored Simplified Technical English.
ui-copy-review: Review interface copy and recovery language with compact quick findings or a full state and accessibility review.
user-testing-chaos-and-random-input: Run seeded random and careless input so a crash, lost state, or broken layout can be replayed.
user-testing-findings-report: Turn session logs and chaos runs into severity-ranked findings, a verdict, and a re-test hand-off.
user-testing-personas: Choose or write simulated users as a want, a state of mind, and a behavior rule for a specific app.
user-testing-playbook: Test an app the way different users would, find where it breaks or disappoints, and route to the linked User Testing skills.
user-testing-scenarios: Turn an app and its personas into scenarios and a persona-by-situation-by-environment test matrix.
user-testing-session-runner: Run one simulated session in character, log expectation versus result, and capture evidence.
wonder-design-workflow: Create, change, verify, and save scoped Wonder designs with clear proof boundaries.
